title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specific campus spaces Cornell students use for late-night study, quiet focus, and collaborative work beyond the standard tour stops.

cards.title: The 24/7 Slope-Side Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Access this renovated space 24/7 with your Cornell ID for panoramic views of Libe Slope and comfortable lounge seating for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study lounge in Uris Library known for its western views and late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cocktail Lounge in Uris Library is available for quiet and group study 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with a current Cornell ID card for after-hours access.
cards.source_title: Spaces in Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; Cornell ID required for entry after standard building hours.

cards.title: Quiet Basement Focus Zone
cards.subtitle: Olin Library
cards.notes: Head to the Olin basement for a silent environment with comfortable couches and large tables, ideal for deep focus away from main floor traffic.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, lower-level study area in Olin Library favored for its silent atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin Lower Level Commons is listed as an open study space available to all library patrons without a reservation.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces - Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open during Olin Library standard hours; typically closes at 9:00 PM or later during semesters.

cards.title: Ag Quad's All-Night Anchor
cards.subtitle: Mann Library
cards.notes: Use your ID card to access the Mann lobby and Room 103 at any hour for collaborative work and computer access on the Ag Quad.
cards.short_summary: The lobby and select rooms of Mann Library are accessible 24/7 for student study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mann Library lobby, Room 112, and Mann 103 are open 24/7 to members of the Cornell community via card swipe access.
cards.source_title: Find a Space - Mann Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Lobby and Room 103 open 24/7 via Cornell ID card swipe.

cards.title: Engineering's Social Engine
cards.subtitle: Duffield Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this high-ceilinged atrium for group projects or casual study; it remains open 24/7 and features a cafe for daytime breaks.
cards.short_summary: A large, 24-hour atrium in the Engineering Quad used for collaborative study and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Duffield Hall atrium is open 24/7 and provides a space where faculty and students can interact in a relaxed environment.
cards.source_title: Duffield Hall Space and Reservation System - Cornell Engineering

cards.title: Victorian Gothic Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Sage Hall
cards.notes: Study under the glass ceiling of this historic atrium during public hours; it offers a mix of high-top tables and cozy seating near the cafe.
cards.short_summary: A soaring, glass-ceilinged atrium in Sage Hall used as a community hub and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Sage Hall features a soaring atrium that serves as a hub for the community, with standard public hours from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays.
cards.source_title: Sage Hall - Johnson School Facilities | Johnson at Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Public hours: Mon-Fri 7 AM - 8 PM, Sat-Sun 7 AM - 5 PM.

cards.title: The Glass-Walled Science Hub
cards.subtitle: Physical Sciences Building
cards.notes: Utilize the floor-to-ceiling glass walls as writing surfaces for brainstorming in this modern, sunlit space connecting Clark and Baker Labs.
cards.short_summary: A modern 6,700-square-foot atrium designed for interdisciplinary collaboration and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Physical Sciences Building (PSB) contains an atrium connecting it to Clark Hall and Baker Lab, featuring glass walls that offer writing surfaces.
cards.source_title: About the Physical Sciences Building - Research & Innovation Facilities Services
cards.access_notes: Generally open 24/7 for students; some areas may require card access after hours.

cards.title: The Silent 'Harry Potter' Room
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Experience absolute silence in this three-story Victorian library; it is strictly for quiet study and houses historic book collections.
cards.short_summary: A historic, multi-tier library within Uris Library dedicated to silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: The A.D. White Library in Uris Library offers comfortable seating in a 19th-century interior and is designated as a silent study space.
cards.source_title: AD White Library - Cornell University Library
cards.access_notes: Open during Uris Library building hours; strictly silent.

cards.title: Rustic Retreat for Grads
cards.subtitle: Big Red Barn
cards.notes: Climb to the mezzanine for a cozy study spot with lounge furniture overlooking the main hall of this 1870s carriage house.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs lounge area in the Big Red Barn used for small group gatherings and leisurely study.
cards.evidence_claim: The upstairs mezzanine of the Big Red Barn has lounge furniture for small group gatherings and leisurely study.
cards.access_notes: Building hours: Mon-Thu 8 AM - 10 PM, Fri 8 AM - 4 PM; primarily serves graduate students.

cards.title: The Student Union Living Room
cards.subtitle: Willard Straight Hall
cards.notes: Find a comfortable armchair in Room 404 to study or socialize in a warm, wood-paneled environment at the heart of campus.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, informal study and social space located on the 4th floor of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Browsing Library (room 404) in Willard Straight Hall is a comfortable place to study, have a snack, and socialize.
cards.source_title: Willard Straight Hall Student Union - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7:00 AM - 11:00 PM during the academic semester.

cards.title: The Tech-Forward Commons
cards.subtitle: Gates Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the open study areas and meeting rooms in this modern computing hub, featuring integrated technology and collaborative layouts.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art building hub for computing and information science with open study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Gates Hall offers a variety of meeting rooms and event spaces suitable for group work, with Room G01 open during building hours.
cards.access_notes: Open 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM weekdays and 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM weekends.
